definitions.projection_pattern: Actual physical bits for branch root projections.
definitions.colocated_chain_pattern: Physical bits, only when each pre-join branch chain stays on one device.
definitions.isolated_branch_mask: Branch bits XOR the common device of ALL nodes outside this layer's branch set; independent local witnesses.
definitions.prefix_cut: A split of deterministic graph topology order into two constant, different device regions; not tensor or pipeline parallelism.
definitions.symmetry: Exchange classes describe model symmetry; both actual physical assignments remain separate.
